context: A boss reviews a corporate bond schedule with his manager
purpose: Teach: 償還/異論/加算/要し/キープ/区間/巨額/組み込ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の社債償還スケジュール、最終確認したいんだが。
lines.en: I'd like to do a final check on this term's corporate bond redemption schedule.
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening, calm but direct executive tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、第三四半期に巨額の償還が集中しておりまして、資金繰りに少々注意を要します。
lines.en: Yes, a massive redemption is concentrated in Q3, so cash flow requires a bit of caution.
lines.style: Polite manager reporting, measured and slightly cautious delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。借換債の発行コストに、手数料の加算分は織り込んであるか?
lines.en: I see. Have you factored in the added fees on top of the refinancing bond issuance cost?
lines.style: Probing follow-up question, sharp and detail-oriented executive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。新発債の利回り想定も保守的にキープしてあります。
lines.en: Of course. We've also kept the yield assumption on the new issue conservative.
lines.style: Confident reassurance, professional manager handling specifics smoothly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 六月から九月までの区間がやはり山場だな。ここを乗り切る計画に異論はないか?
lines.en: The stretch from June to September is clearly the critical phase. Any objections to the plan for getting through it?
lines.style: Strategic summarizing, inviting pushback with confident gravitas.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 異論はございません。コミットメントラインも予備枠として組み込まれています。
lines.en: No objections. The commitment line is also built in as a backup facility.
lines.style: Firm agreement, deferential but assured corporate manager voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よし。役員会の資料にも、その予備枠を明記して提出してくれ。
lines.en: Good. Make sure that backup facility is clearly noted in the board materials too.
lines.style: Decisive closing instruction, brisk authoritative boss directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。本日中に修正版をお手元にお届けします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the revised version on your desk by end of day.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgement, efficient and respectful subordinate close.
